verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user-built automations is a fair question for a CDP, since rules, audiences, and connections could plausibly carry version history. The pack shows no such capability. The only versioning evidence covers the vendor's own API surfaces (DSR API v3, Warehouse Sync API v2) and a vendor product changelog. Neither lets a user version, review, or roll back their own automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
